title: Deep Neural Networks Training Efficiency: Does Grokking Modify its Dynamics?
abstract: arXiv:2611.18396v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study whether grokking, the delayed emergence of out-of-distribution generalization after apparent overfitting, alters training efficiency in deep neural networks, where efficiency is measured as accuracy per unit energy. Using two canonical settings, modular arithmetic and MNIST, we analyze two neural network models under 16-, 32-, and 64-bit precision and use Orthograd to test whether grokking produces noticeable deviations from the typically decreasing dynamics of training efficiency. We consider both short training runs of up to 500 epochs and long training runs of up to 20,000 epochs, and in both cases identify grokking as a sharp improvement in test accuracy after a sustained train-test gap. In the short-horizon experiments, applying Orthograd at progressively stronger levels during early training does not induce grokking, and efficiency remains smoothly decreasing. translated_title: 深度神经网络训练效率：Grokking（顿悟）现象会改变其动态吗？
translated_abstract: 我们研究了grokking（顿悟）现象——即在明显过拟合之后延迟出现的分布外泛化能力——是否会改变深度神经网络的训练效率，其中效率被定义为单位能量所获得的准确率。在模运算和MNIST两个经典实验场景中，我们分析了两个神经网络模型在16位、32位和64位精度下的表现，并使用Orthograd来检验grokking是否会使训练效率偏离其通常递减的动态规律。我们同时考察了长达500个epoch的短时程训练和长达20,000个epoch的长时程训练，并在两种情况下都将grokking识别为在持续的训练-测试差距之后测试准确率的急剧提升。在短时程实验中，在训练早期施加强度逐渐增强的Orthograd并未诱发grokking，训练效率仍保持平滑递减。在长时程实验中，Orthograd成功诱发了grokking，但……
tldr: 本文通过在模运算和MNIST任务上以多种数值精度进行长短时程训练实验，利用Orthograd诱发grokking并系统考察其与训练效率（单位能量准确率）的关系，发现grokking的发生并未显著改变训练效率通常递减的动态规律。
en_tdlr: This paper investigates whether grokking modifies the dynamics of training efficiency (accuracy per unit energy) in deep neural networks using modular arithmetic and MNIST at 16-, 32-, and 64-bit precision with Orthograd across short and long training runs, finding that grokking does not produce noticeable deviations from the typically decreasing efficiency dynamics.
